Runtime evidence: (1) hosted Harbor v2 run (raw-evidence-index, hashes verified) graded Oracle 0.9917 with render/constraints/functional/polish/visual all produced and nop 0; git show 9766459f confirms tests/Dockerfile, test.sh, .dockerignore, environment/Dockerfile and package.json are byte-identical to this candidate, so that run exercised this exact verifier image definition end to end. (2) My local probe (container removed via --rm) in existing image cw-editor-verifier:current, whose tool set matches every pin (node v22.23.2, Python 3.12.14, claude-code 2.1.281, codex 0.151.0, rewardkit 0.1.7, @playwright/mcp 0.0.79, express 5.1.0, better-sqlite3 12.4.1, Chrome for Testing 152 at /usr/local/bin/chromium), launched the FROZEN v3 solution/app/server.js exactly as test.sh does (setsid env -i, uid 65534 via setpriv, cwd /, HOME/DB_PATH under /tmp/submission): /api/health 200, / 200 (4793 bytes), app.db created by nobody, log 'Kittle & Rowe matter chat on port 3000'. Counterexample search: an agent app adding an extra npm package in /app/node_modules still runs because test.sh copies /app (non-escaping symlinks allowed) and Node resolves local modules first; a conforming app using node:sqlite or built-ins also runs on the same Node 22 major. No plausible conforming app fails for lack of a verifier runtime component, and a broken app gains nothing from the image. Notes (not defects, template-controlled, must not be edited per AGENTS.md): base images use floating tags (node:22-bookworm-slim, python:3.12-slim) and apt packages are unpinned, so a rebuild can drift in Node minor/glibc; tools that matter for grading are version-pinned. A full configured judge run of THESE v3 bytes is absent (raw-evidence-index scope) - that gap belongs to the workload/full-grading runtime records, not to image content, and is not claimed here as an Oracle score.
